findings.title: Possible plaintext credential
findings.evidence: Detected a credential-like structure. The report does not repeat the value and did not test whether it is valid.
findings.action: Review manually. If real, rotate it first and remove it from Markdown; if it is an example, replace it with an obvious placeholder.

findings.title: Skill frontmatter is missing or malformed
findings.action: Add parseable YAML frontmatter with non-empty name and description fields.

findings.title: Complete, same-name generic Skill duplicate
findings.evidence: The entry and complete bundle manifest/hash match inside one scan root; canonical candidate: .agents/skills/pdf-helper/SKILL.md.
findings.action: Confirm both discovery paths are in the actual loading scope, then move only the duplicate to a recoverable archive and retain the bundle hash and rollback manifest.

findings.title: Referenced local file does not exist
findings.evidence: A local Markdown reference cannot be resolved. The original target is not repeated to avoid leaking path parameters.
findings.action: Update or remove the stale reference; do not let an Agent execute the affected workflow until repaired.

findings.title: Absolute path is no longer valid
findings.evidence: The instruction contains an absolute path that does not exist on the current filesystem.
findings.action: Use a project-relative path, Skill-root path, or another currently verifiable location.

findings.title: Possible legacy reasoning scaffold
findings.evidence: Found a rule requiring explicit chain-of-thought or a fixed step-by-step reasoning format.
findings.action: Run representative A/B tasks with and without the rule; do not remove it from wording alone.

findings.title: Possible legacy reasoning scaffold
findings.evidence: Found a rule requiring explicit chain-of-thought or a fixed step-by-step reasoning format.
findings.action: Run representative A/B tasks with and without the rule; do not remove it from wording alone.

findings.title: Unconditional tool use may impose a context tax
findings.evidence: The rule binds tool use to every or all tasks.
findings.action: Use triggers based on version sensitivity, risk, or task type, then compare tool calls and task success.

findings.title: Recheck the Context7 dependency
findings.evidence: The instruction references Context7; verify its availability and scope in the current runtime.
findings.action: Inspect the current tool list. If unavailable, remove the mandate and consult first-party documentation only when version sensitivity requires it.

limitations: Static findings do not prove that removing an instruction improves task quality.
Model and runtime obsolescence requires current first-party capability evidence.
Domain Skills, safety rules, authorization gates, and project invariants are excluded from automatic retirement.
RETIRE requires a complete identical Skill bundle, the same generic Skill name, and both discovery paths inside the same scan root.
No finding authorizes deletion; changes should be archived, reviewed, tested, and reversible.
